verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS email API that ships a CLI, SDKs, and a web console. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or an opt-out control. The SOC 2 Type II report is a compliance attestation, a different control from a user-facing telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
